name: Cap Formentor
description: Port de Pollença out to the Formentor lighthouse and back on the cape's only road. About 40 km with 950 m of climbing.

road_report.summary: Meets the LOOPS Road Standard: no main roads, nothing over 80 km/h, 100% paved.

name: Rocacorba, Girona
description: Girona's big climb, there and back: out through Sarrià de Ter and Cornellà del Terri to Banyoles, up Rocacorba from Pujarnol to the top (about 970 m), down the same road and home by Canet d'Adri and Sant Gregori. About 107 km with 2,000 m of climbing.

road_report.summary: Compromise: 1.1 km on a national road (main road); 1.1 km on a national road (main road) (+2 more).

name: Cruz Grande and Pico de las Nieves Loop
description: The mountain classic as a real loop: up through San Bartolomé de Tirajana to the Degollada de Cruz Grande and Ayacata, on to Pico de las Nieves at the island's roof (the road tops out near 1,920 m), then down the east side past Cazadores to Agüimes and back over Temisas and Santa Lucía. About 98 km and 2,900 m of climbing; the GC-60 over Cruz Grande is a main road.

road_report.summary: Compromise: 10.6 km on a primary road (main road); 4.3 km on a primary road near the start/finish (main road) (+9 more).

name: Bay of Pollensa Loop
description: Round the bay from Port de Pollença: inland through Pollença and the lanes to Alcúdia, out along the Cap des Pinar road towards the Ermita de la Victòria, then home along the bay. About 46 km and gently rolling.

road_report.summary: Meets the LOOPS Road Standard: no main roads, nothing over 80 km/h, 100% paved.
